items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: No, I was there most all of the time. And -- but I had such a good relationship with the proprietor.

ctx.x: Well, were you there constantly or were you off sometimes?
No, I was there most all of the time. And -- but I had such a good relationship with the proprietor.
I would think so. You were there 21 years.
